name: MVGS_CM_TNM_SCT_UICC
title: MV-GenomSeq TNM category: SNOMED CT to UICC
description: KDK diagnosisOd.tnmClassifications[] (SNOMED CT TNM category qualifier values) to the UICC TNM code required by `value.coding:uicc` of mii-pr-onko-tnm-{t,n,m}-kategorie (REPRESENTATIONS #2, DISCUSS-TD #2). Group 1 is the element-wise inverse of the MII Onko 2027.0.0-ballot.1 (= 2026.0.3) ConceptMaps mii-cm-onko-tnm-uicc-sct-clinical and -pathological, restricted to T/N/M categories (no y/r/a descriptors, no stage groups); every SNOMED code is unique, the c/p prefix of the source concept is carried as `product` (property = mii-ex-onko-tnm-cp-praefix, value c|p). Source edition = target edition of the MII maps. Group 2 accepts UICC strings that senders put into the SNOMED code field (identity over mii-vs-onko-tnm-{t,n,m}-kategorie-werte). SNOMED codes outside group 1 (e.g. AJCC qualifier values) are unmatched; the converter keeps them in mii-pr-onko-weitere-klassifikationen.
